name: BoMed Healthcare Autonomy Platform
tagline: Permission-gated MCP tools and A2A agents for patient-controlled healthcare — every operation checked against a live trust graph, every resource in FHIR.
description: BoMed gives healthcare AI agents a permission layer they've been missing. 10 MCP tools expose patient-controlled operations — grants, vitals, appointments, insurance — all returning FHIR R4 resources. An A2A-compliant AutoBook Agent schedules autonomously within patient-defined policy constraints. SHARP context propagation passes patient identity and FHIR tokens through multi-agent chains on Prompt Opinion. Bilateral World ID verification ensures both patients AND providers are cryptographically verified. Revocation is instant — checked live on every request, no caching, no cooperative behavior required.
hackathon: Agents Assemble: The Healthcare AI Endgame
